cleared.check: Is the value frame hook that earlier clearances read the same code on every public revision: check_blocklist_and_create_log, before_frame_init, checked_frame_init, init_deferred_frame_with_transfer_log and init_precompile_frame_with_transfer_log in crates/evm/src/evm.rs on main, master, release/0.8, tag v0.8.6, commit b1179556 and tag v0.8.5.
cleared.result: Yes. The five function bodies are byte-identical on main (and master, which has the same file) and on tag v0.8.6. The whole evm.rs and opcode.rs are identical on v0.8.5, v0.8.6, b1179556 and release/0.8. The hook is at lines 516 to 605 on v0.8.6 and 499 to 588 on main; main is the older branch (its CHANGELOG ends at v0.8.0), so the line range in L-944 belongs to the tag. On the tag the hook fails a value CALL from or to address(0) (line 534), from or to an account whose slot keccak(account, 2) at 0x1800000000000000000000000000000000000001 is nonzero (lines 542-567), and to an account self-destructed earlier in the transaction (lines 571-593); it emits an EIP-7708 Transfer log from 0xff...fe only for a nonzero amount between distinct accounts and only when the frame succeeds (lines 595-604, 860-889). A zero amount skips all checks (line 622). This is what F-125 describes; nothing in these functions changes the amount moved or the success flag in any other case.

cleared.check: Task 2 of L-944: the last 2,000 mined Arc transactions, counted back from block 33,140,226, in which the PoolManager sends or receives native USDC (system emitter Transfer logs naming the PoolManager), blocks 33,121,767 to 33,140,226. No sampling, so no seed applies. Each was rerun whole in the cycle 17 reference interpreter (pyevm_tx17.py, imported unchanged) with state read lazily from the parent block through eth_getStorageAt, eth_getCode, eth_getBalance and eth_getTransactionCount, EIP-7702 authorizations applied, Arc's value frame rules and EIP-7708 logs added from evm.rs v0.8.6, and NativeCoinAuthority.transfer and NativeCoinControl.isBlocklisted modelled from the v0.8.6 precompile source. Compared: status, every receipt log in order, the block-end value of every PoolManager slot the run read or wrote, the PoolManager native balance change and each payout recipient's balance change. Transactions that differed and were not first in their block were rerun with all earlier transactions of the block on one state.
cleared.result: No difference in any PoolManager result. The set holds 2395 settles with value (1,068 native Transfer logs into the PoolManager in 1,061 transactions, 175,530 USDC) and native payouts (1,327 logs out of the PoolManager in 960 transactions, 181,495 USDC), inside 15626 PoolManager frames (2,918 take, 2,074 settle, 2,084 sync, 2,078 swap, 47 modifyLiquidity, 41 mint, 4 burn, 8 initialize, 2,114 unlock, plus reads). 1,998 were rerun, 2 were set aside (one calls the Arc precompile 0x1800000000000000000000000000000000000003 with selector 1595ec0b, one reaches CREATE2, which the interpreter lacks). 1769 match the chain in every log, status and checked slot on the first pass and 126 more on the block-prefix pass. 8470 PoolManager slots were checked against block-end storage in 1824 transactions with no later PoolManager transaction in the block, all equal. In the 1671 blocks where only this transaction moved the PoolManager's native balance, the balance change equals the reference and equals the net of the system emitter logs for the PoolManager to the wei. 552 recipient balance changes were checked, all equal; 726 recipients were the sender or coinbase or shared the block and were not checked. The 102 transactions that still differ after both passes differ only in logs of contracts that report gas: UserOperationEvent actualGasUsed and actualGasCost of the EntryPoints 0x4337084d9e255ff0702461cf8895ce9e3b5ff108 (80) and 0x0000000071727de22e5e9d8baf0edac6f37da032 (20, one with the gas refund Transfer to the bundler), and word 5 of event 0x2fc0d44e of 0x69460570c93f9de5e2edbc3052bf10125f0ca22d (2). In all of them the PoolManager logs, the PoolManager native Transfer logs, the status and the checked slots are equal. One more, 0xa96f0c92...2abd, a Multicall3 aggregate3 that ran 15 iterations of a loop on chain and 23 in the reference; eth_simulateV1 of the block prefix on arc.drpc.org at the mined gas limit gives the mined 95 logs and at twice the limit gives 127 logs with 4 PoolManager logs, the reference's result, so the loop is bounded by remaining gas, which the reference does not meter. Limits: no Arc endpoint serves debug_ or trace_ methods (-32601), so the output of each PoolManager frame was not compared directly, only through the logs, storage and balances it leaves; 23 inner unlock frames fail in the reference inside successful transactions, and their effects are consistent with the chain's logs.

cleared.check: Task 3 of L-944: native take from the real PoolManager at 0x8366a39c...0951 by eth_call with state overrides (a driver at a fresh address calls unlock, runs the items, records success, return data and balances, and reverts), sent in JSON-RPC batches bracketed by web3_clientVersion and arc_getVersion to both Arc endpoints at the same block 33,142,279, and the same scripts to the Ethereum PoolManager 0x000000000004444c...8A90 at block 26,495,018. Recipients: a codeless address, a contract that reverts, a contract that loops until out of gas, an address made blocklisted by a state override of its slot at 0x1800...01 (no public blocklisted address could be listed: getLogs over the precompile's Blocklisted event needs more than the 1,000 block range the official endpoint allows, dRPC allows 100, and the explorer API returned a challenge), address(0), the precompiles 0x01, 0x02, 0x04 and 0x100, the Arc addresses 0x1800...00 to ...03 and the USDC face 0x3600...00, the PoolManager itself, and a contract that self-destructs when called. Amounts 0, 1 and the rest of the balance (2,410,964.98 USDC on Arc). Also settle with value 1, sync(address(0)) with value, settle with value 0 and take with value.
cleared.result: The two Arc endpoints return byte-identical records on all 17 scripts (54 items), so the builds 37812c61 and 8e8edb7a agree on every probed value path. Against Ethereum, success flags, return data and balance changes are equal except where F-125 and F-049 already say: a payout of 1 or of the full balance to address(0) or to the blocklisted address fails on Arc with NativeTransferFailed wrapping Error('Zero address not allowed') or Error('Blocked address') and moves nothing, and every take to 0x1800...00 to ...03 or to 0x3600...00 fails on Arc even with amount 0, because those addresses reject empty calldata, while they are plain accounts on Ethereum. Each failure reverts only the take, so the caller's delta is never debited without a transfer or the reverse (src/PoolManager.sol:291-297, src/types/Currency.sol:44-52). The reverting and gas burning recipients give identical wrapped errors on both chains. The precompiles 0x01, 0x02, 0x04 and 0x100 accept value on both, and the full PoolManager balance can be paid to them, which the caller owes and must settle. A take to the PoolManager fails on both, since no contract in src/ outside src/test declares receive or fallback. The self-destructing contract was created before the transaction, so it is not marked destroyed and the take succeeds on both; the destroyed-in-transaction branch of the hook was not reached by these probes. The settle items behave alike on all three: settle credits msg.value, sync and take are not payable.

cleared.check: Do the Arc precompiles that the USDC face calls (NativeCoinAuthority.transfer at 0x1800...00, NativeCoinControl.isBlocklisted at 0x1800...01) behave in mined transactions as the v0.8.6 source says, given that most mined native settlements and payouts on Arc pass through the face 0x3600 as well.
cleared.result: Yes in the mined sample. The replay models transfer(from, to, amount) as: caller must be 0x3600, zero addresses and blocklisted accounts refused, a zero amount moves nothing and logs nothing, otherwise balances move by exactly amount and a Transfer log from 0xff...fe is emitted when from differs from to (native_coin_authority.rs v0.8.6 lines 286-345), and isBlocklisted as a read of slot keccak(account, 2) of 0x1800...01. With that model every one of the 1,998 rerun transactions gives the mined emitter logs, and the PoolManager balance changes equal those logs to the wei in all 1,671 isolated blocks. The 18 versus 6 decimal split and its rounding are cleared in earlier cycles and were not reopened.

leads.question: On both Arc endpoints, does a native take to an account that a contract created and self-destructed earlier in the same transaction fail with the hook's self-destructed error and move nothing, as evm.rs v0.8.6 lines 571-593 say? The cycle 21 probes could not reach that branch because the driver has no CREATE.
leads.why: It is the one branch of the value frame hook that no mined transaction or probe has exercised at the unpublished builds 37812c61 and 8e8edb7a.

leads.question: dRPC reports v0.8.6 at commit 8e8edb7a while the published v0.8.6 image and tag are b1179556. Rerun the probe set and the replay when either Arc endpoint reports a new arc_getVersion, and record whether Circle publishes 37812c61 or 8e8edb7a.
leads.why: Two public endpoints run builds whose source is not published, and they could diverge from each other or from the tag in a later release.

leadResults.answer: No published artifact names the revisions behind v0.8.6-rc1 (37812c61) or dRPC's v0.8.6 (8e8edb7a): raw.githubusercontent.com has neither commit, the Cloudsmith images hold only 0.8.6 = b1179556 (the binary embeds that commit and the tag matches it), the image has no labels, and github.com and the explorer refused this client with 403. The value hook is byte-identical on main, release/0.8 and v0.8.6 (lines 516-605 on the tag, 499-588 on main). The replay of the last 2,000 mined native settlements and payouts (blocks 33,121,767 to 33,140,226) in the reference interpreter from parent-block storage found no difference in any PoolManager log, slot, native balance change or recipient balance change; the 103 remaining log differences are gas reports of EntryPoints and a relayer and one gas-bounded loop confirmed with eth_simulateV1. eth_call probes of 54 native take and settle items give byte-identical results on both unpublished builds, and differ from Ethereum only where F-125 and F-049 already record. No unprivileged path makes a native payout or settlement differ from the source's model.
